claims.text: The tool extracts and indexes document content in Qdrant, plans an outline and researches each section against the local collection.

evidence.quote:
Oqura's deepdoc is a local deep-research tool that turns your own files into a
structured Markdown report. It extracts and indexes the content, plans the report,
researches every section against the local collection, and combines the results into
one final document.

- Provide a directory containing PDF, DOCX, PPTX, image, TXT, or Markdown resources.
- DeepDoc extracts the text, keeps page and source metadata, and creates searchable
  chunks in Qdrant.
- A report planner creates the initial structure from your topic and outline. You can
  approve it or request changes before research starts.
- One research agent runs for every report section. Each agent:
  - Generates focused research queries.
  - Retrieves a shortlist of candidate chunks from Qdrant.
  - Uses Jev to judge relevance, usable evidence, contradiction, and
    prompt-injection-like content.
  - Filters and reranks the candidates before evidence reaches the writing LLM.
  - Uses Jev reflection scores to find subsections that still lack evidence.
  - Generates new queries for missing coverage, up to the configured reflection limit.
  - Writes the completed section from the accepted local evidence.
- The final report writer combines all completed sections and exports a Markdown file.

claims.text: Jev judges and reranks retrieved chunks and scores missing coverage; a separate LLM plans, queries and writes while Python controls retries.

evidence.quote:
DeepDoc uses TypeSafe's Jev model to improve the research process without replacing
the generative LLM. Jev checks and reranks the chunks returned by Qdrant, then checks
whether the collected evidence covers every required subsection. The configured LLM
still handles planning, query generation, synthesis, and report writing, while Python
uses Jev's probabilities to make explicit filtering and retry decisions.

- One research agent runs for every report section. Each agent:
  - Generates focused research queries.
  - Retrieves a shortlist of candidate chunks from Qdrant.
  - Uses Jev to judge relevance, usable evidence, contradiction, and
    prompt-injection-like content.
  - Filters and reranks the candidates before evidence reaches the writing LLM.
  - Uses Jev reflection scores to find subsections that still lack evidence.
  - Generates new queries for missing coverage, up to the configured reflection limit.

Jev returns typed probabilities; thresholds, ranking, retry limits, and graph routing
remain ordinary Python logic in the application.

claims.text: Supply a topic, outline and resource directory through the CLI; default configuration needs OpenAI and TypeSafe keys and saves reports in output_folder.

evidence.quote:
Open the `.env` file in a text editor and fill in the keys used by your configuration.
`OPENAI_API_KEY` and `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` are required for the default setup:

The CLI will ask for a topic, an outline or goal, and the local resource directory.
Completed reports are saved in `output_folder`.

### Optional: `configuration.py`

You can customize model behavior, parallelism, retrieval size, reflection limits, and
Jev thresholds in `configuration.py`.

claims.text: Jev thresholds are starting points to validate on your documents. Section writing can begin when the configured retry limit is reached.

evidence.quote:
```text
Query generation
  -> Qdrant retrieval
  -> Jev evidence gate and reranker
  -> Evidence accumulator
  -> Jev subsection coverage reflection
       -> Query generation again when coverage is missing and retries remain
       -> Section writer when coverage is sufficient or the retry limit is reached

The Jev thresholds are starting points rather than universal constants. Evaluate them
on representative local documents before changing them. Increasing `n_points` can
improve candidate recall, but it also creates more Jev evaluations because every
query/chunk pair is judged independently. `evidence_keep_per_query` controls how many
of those candidates continue to the evidence accumulator.

tr.h1: DeepDoc: Jev kanıt kontrolüyle yerel belge araştırması
tr.description: DeepDoc yerel dosyaları Markdown raporlarına dönüştürür; Jev ile kanıtları süzer ve alt bölüm kapsamını denetler.
tr.summary: Belgeleri çıkarıp Qdrant’ta indeksler, taslak planlar ve her bölümü yerel koleksiyondan araştırır. Jev parçaları değerlendirip sıralar ve kanıt eksiklerini puanlar; ayrı LLM planlar, sorgular, yazar, Python yeniden denemeleri yönetir.

sections.heading: Amaç ve hedef kitle
sections.text: Belgeleri çıkarıp Qdrant’ta indeksler, taslak planlar ve her bölümü yerel koleksiyondan araştırır.

sections.heading: Jev’in rolü
sections.text: Jev parçaları değerlendirip sıralar ve kanıt eksiklerini puanlar; ayrı LLM planlar, sorgular, yazar, Python yeniden denemeleri yönetir.

sections.heading: Kullanım
sections.text: CLI üzerinden konu, taslak ve dizin verilir; varsayılan yapı OpenAI ile TypeSafe anahtarları ister, raporları output_folder içine kaydeder.

sections.heading: Kapsam ve sınırlar
sections.text: Jev eşikleri kendi belgelerinizle doğrulanacak başlangıç değerleridir. Yeniden deneme sınırına ulaşıldığında da bölüm yazımı başlar.

it.title: DeepDoc: ricerca locale con controlli delle prove Jev
it.h1: DeepDoc: ricerca locale con controlli delle prove Jev
it.description: DeepDoc trasforma file locali in rapporti Markdown, usando Jev per filtrare prove e verificare la copertura delle sottosezioni.
it.summary: Estrae documenti, li indicizza in Qdrant, pianifica una scaletta e ricerca ogni sezione nella raccolta locale. Jev valuta e riordina frammenti e lacune; un altro LLM pianifica, interroga e scrive, mentre Python gestisce i tentativi.

sections.heading: Scopo e destinatari
sections.text: Estrae documenti, li indicizza in Qdrant, pianifica una scaletta e ricerca ogni sezione nella raccolta locale.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Jev valuta e riordina frammenti e lacune; un altro LLM pianifica, interroga e scrive, mentre Python gestisce i tentativi.

sections.heading: Come si usa
sections.text: Si indicano tema, scaletta e directory nella CLI; la configurazione predefinita richiede chiavi OpenAI e TypeSafe e salva in output_folder.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: Le soglie Jev sono valori iniziali da validare sui propri documenti. La stesura inizia anche al raggiungimento del limite di tentativi.
